name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 11 – Am 85
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 11a. Argues that EU funds must be tailored to the needs, priorities and development strategies of each Member State; rejects, therefore, ‘conditionality’ mechanisms or the logic of financing ‘reforms’ pre-determined by the EU, and which cut across a range of instruments and policies, particularly in the allocation of funds; rejects any link between the use and disbursement of funds and economic governance instruments, in particular the European Semester and its country-specific recommendations;
